compute_class_weight: compute class weights for unbalanced datasets using balanced heuristic or custom dictionary mapping
compute_sample_weight: compute per-sample weights by class for unbalanced datasets with optional subsampling indices
create_compute_class_weight_balanced: create balanced class weights from label array y and unique classes using sklearn compute_class_weight
create_compute_class_weight_custom: create custom class weights from a user-defined dictionary mapping class labels to weight values
test_compute_sample_weight_multioutput: test compute_sample_weight with multi-output label arrays and list of weight dictionaries
